Probabilities are my own estimates that the hypothesis holds consistently across all three datasets. "Intuitive" is how a reader would likely judge it at first glance.

**Group A: replacing `none` gives a bigger gain than replacing another op (same edge, higher)**
1. e3→conv3x3 | cond e3=none | p≈0.75 | intuitive: yes
2. e4→conv3x3 | cond e4=none | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
3. e5→conv3x3 | cond e5=none | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
4. e0→conv3x3 | cond e0=none | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
5. e1→conv3x3 | cond e1=none | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
6. e2→conv3x3 | cond e2=none | p≈0.5 | intuitive: yes
7. e3→skip_connect | cond e3=none | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
8. e3→avg_pool | cond e3=none | p≈0.55 | intuitive: yes
9. e1→conv1x1 | cond e1=none | p≈0.55 | intuitive: yes
29. e4→skip_connect | cond e4=none | p≈0.45 | intuitive: yes

**Group B: removing an op that is currently valuable (lower)**
10. e3→none | cond e3=skip_connect | p≈0.65 | intuitive: yes
11. e3→none | cond e3=conv3x3 | p≈0.6 | intuitive: yes
12. e5→none | cond e5=conv3x3 | p≈0.55 | intuitive: yes

**Group C: removing an edge hurts more when the downstream path is active (lower)**
13. e0→none | cond e4=conv3x3 | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly
14. e0→none | cond e2=conv3x3 | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly
15. e1→none | cond e5=conv3x3 | p≈0.55 | intuitive: yes
16. e4→none | cond e0=conv3x3 | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly
17. e2→none | cond e5=conv3x3 | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly

**Group D: the gain from adding conv is smaller when a skip on e3 already provides a path (lower)**
18. e5→conv3x3 | cond e3=skip_connect | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly
19. e4→conv3x3 | cond e3=skip_connect | p≈0.5 | intuitive: partly
20. e1→conv3x3 | cond e3=skip_connect | p≈0.45 | intuitive: partly
21. e3→skip_connect | cond e1=conv3x3 | p≈0.4 | intuitive: partly
22. e3→skip_connect | cond e5=none | p≈0.4 | intuitive: partly

**Group E: an edit is useless when its upstream or downstream node is disconnected (lower)**
23. e5→conv3x3 | cond e1=none | p≈0.45 | intuitive: yes

28. e2→conv1x1 | cond e5=none | p≈0.4 | intuitive: yes
30. e5→skip_connect | cond e1=none | p≈0.35 | intuitive: yes
